functions.name: BALANCE
functions.description: NetSuite ending balance (debit minus credit; credit balances are negative). Balance sheet accounts are cumulative; P&L accounts are fiscal year-to-date.

parameters.name: period_or_date
parameters.description: Accounting period name ("Oct 2026") or a date

parameters.name: subsidiary
parameters.description: Subsidiary name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: profit_center
parameters.description: Profit Center name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Department name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode name or internal ID (blank = all)

functions.name: ACTIVITY
functions.description: NetSuite net activity (debit minus credit) for a period or a range of periods.

parameters.name: to_period
parameters.description: Last accounting period (blank = same as from_period)

parameters.name: subsidiary
parameters.description: Subsidiary name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: profit_center
parameters.description: Profit Center name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Department name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location name or internal ID (blank = all)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode name or internal ID (blank = all)
